# Appendix C. Syscall coverage

Generated from `kernel/calls.c`. Chapter 11's warning applies to every row:
**a table entry is not a reachable syscall.** Entries marked *native dispatch*
are handled full-width before the table is consulted, and the entry exists only
so a NULL check passes — editing it changes nothing.

## Summary

| table | entries | implemented | native dispatch | stubs |
|---|--:|--:|--:|--:|
| i386 | 350 | 313 | 0 | 37 |
| amd64 | 323 | 288 | 1 | 34 |
| arm64 / riscv64 | 312 | 223 | 2 | 87 |

riscv64 shares arm64's table: both are asm-generic ABIs with identical
numbering (Chapter 7).
